text: U40 suppresses errors when no failed row is visible. Node reproduction using production sendMessage/upsertMessageNode: hold POST in channel 5, navigate to Wiki (activeId remains 5), reject with 503. Output: view=wiki, visibleFailedRows=0, toasts=0, failed=true. Adding a chat-view guard in memory produces one toast; the visible-chat control produces none. Suppress only when the failed row is actually visible, including checking the current view and viewport.
